description: Explain WHY each top lender ranked where it did for a financing decision. Takes a full decision scenario (same shape as get_financing_decision) and returns a structured per-offer cost breakdown (rate, points, fees, lifetime interest), scoring signals, how much each offer beats the next by, and a plain-language summary of the ranking weights. Use this when a user asks why one lender beat another.

max_providers.description: Maximum number of lenders to explain (1-5). Defaults to 5.

name: explain_ranking

offers.description: Ranked offers with the scoring inputs that produced each position.

beats_next_by.description: Margin over the next-ranked offer, in APR percentage points, dollars per month, and dollars of lifetime interest. All zeros mean it is effectively a tie.

cost_breakdown.description: The cost inputs behind this offer: rate and APR in percent, points, fees and monthly payment in dollars, and lifetime interest in dollars.

rank.description: Position in the ranking, 1 = best weighted score.

signals.description: Scoring signals with their raw value, weight, and contribution to the final score; use them to explain why one lender outranked another.

signals_truncated_from.description: Full number of signals scored before the list above was shortened. Null when nothing was omitted.

product_type.description: Loan or deposit category this result covers, e.g. 'mortgage', 'auto_loan', 'heloc', 'savings'.

request_id.description: Opaque identifier for this call, useful only for support or debugging; never show it to the user.

summary.description: Plain-English statement of the weighting scheme used and what separated the top offers; quote this when explaining the ranking.
